claims.question: q4
claims.claim: The stochastic nature of LLM generation causes intrinsic behavioral inconsistency, so the same agent may succeed in one execution but fail in another under identical inputs.
claims.quote: However, the stochastic nature of LLM generation introduces intrinsic behavioral inconsistency: the same agent may succeed in one execution but fail in another under identical inputs.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Diagnosing such inconsistencies is a major challenge for developers because agent execution logs are often lengthy, unstructured, and difficult to compare across runs.
claims.quote: Diagnosing such inconsistencies remains a major challenge for developers, as agent execution logs are often lengthy, unstructured, and difficult to compare across runs.

claims.question: q4
claims.claim: Existing debugging and evaluation tools mainly inspect single executions and offer limited support for understanding why agent behaviors diverge across repeated runs.
claims.quote: Existing debugging and evaluation tools primarily focus on inspecting single executions, offering limited support for understanding how and why agent behaviors diverge across repeated runs.
